summary: Season 9 'The Undertow Approaches' introduces the Duskport region, new boss Invertipolis Sentinel, and new heroes including Sia, Syonis, Holfast, Rhyviel, and Celestine. The limited Aura hero Anneliesis has a confirmed banner release date of November 8th, accessible to both Season 9 and Season 1 servers. The Account Valuation event returns for new accounts, offering up to 15,000 Wyrmarrow for submitting account screenshots within 14 days. Additional additions include a server-wide three-team PvP arena, new exclusive artifacts, shop expansions, and upcoming seasonal events.
